name: Meet at the Grave
label: Quest
description: Meet at the Grave: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This elixir will allow you to speak with one that you would not normally even see...
Take the Videre elixir, along with Linken's sword, to the graveyard just outside Gadgetzan in Tanaris. Once there, drink the potion. You may be quite surprised at the results, but do not be alarmed.
In your "other" form, head due north until you reach the mountains. You'll find the one you need to speak with in one of the rocky crevices. His name is Gaeriyan.
Remember, he will only speak to you in that form...

clips.title: Completion
paras: It has been long since any have come to talk with me...
